input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset (and other) email links are built from BASE_URL, which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set in the deployment. That's why the reset link points to localhost in production. Fix by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is set to the real public URL in the production environment, and/or failing loudly (or using a safer default) when it's missing instead of silently falling back to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost instead of production URL
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The `BASE_URL` constant falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` is not set, and this fallback is being used in production, causing password reset (and other) email links to point at localhost for users. Instead of silently defaulting to localhost, `BASE_URL` should come from a validated application config value (e.g. a `publicUrl` entry in `../config`) that is required to be set correctly in each environment, or the code should throw/log loudly if `PUBLIC_URL` is missing in production rather than defaulting to localhost. This ensures `passwordResetEmail`, `rollupText`, and `scheduledExportEmail` all generate links that work for real users.
